_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves and neither a confirmed upside breaker (fed_liquidity >15 + funding <55) nor downside breaker (VIX >20 + exchange_netflow >70) present, the statistically honest call is to hold this coil until a directional trigger fires.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction while narrative implies a LONG bias; the analyst's stricter structural read and the 0% volatility statistic justify siding with HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 15 AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 85 with funding staying below 55
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with exchange_netflow >70 AND cvd_btc_pct_30d drops below 50, signaling risk-off distribution into the coil
